Subject: POC kickoff — proposing staggered hands-on windows (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo today — want to move fast on the POC. Our engineering and ops teams are distributed (New York, Berlin, Bangalore) so we need hands-on sessions that rotate across timezones.

High-level asks:
- A kickoff call to align scope and success criteria (30m)
- Three hands-on workshops focused on prompt review, routing rules, and a light load run (60–90m each), ideally in staggered windows so local engineers can participate
- A short runbook for load-test expectations and a CSV with suggested matrix for throughput/latency targets

We can be flexible next week but prefer: May 18 morning ET, May 18 late afternoon CET, and May 19 early IST. Can Redwood provide a suggested schedule and a concise playbook we can share internally?

I attached a short org chart for participant names. Looking forward — Anna

4) Hands-on session C (APAC-friendly repeat) — May 19 04:00 UTC / 09:30 IST — 75m

Attachments: poc-playbook-v1.pdf (playbook draft), load-test-matrix.csv (initial targets).

Dev and Lauren, can you confirm capacity for these windows? Marcus, can you own the load-run checklist and brief ops?
